Dynamic/JS resolution is not proven by syntax. Fresh paired private build/acceptance remains pending; public installation is held.

### Operation5 failure, no replay

All six recovery-original SHA256s remain equal. No target launch/conversion occurred.

### Existing owner repaired
Tool code head e475951816536a2282278afd60e67b307e5f8f27; e1cbe5a41 adds docs only.
- Reuse existing target --goal-format-candidate CLI to prepare and strictly validate without Registration.
- The ORIGINAL validated StoppedOwnerBatch installs those held bytes, using the existing RegistryStore writer/private guard and original wire/OFD. No fake lifecycle or weakened pre-write wire check.

- Original-runtime recovery refuses before any old decoder once carry preimages exist. Partial carry remains stopped, not implicitly rolled back/replayed.
- The existing conversion owner returns the number of author fields it added; holders fold that result. No second counting policy or fallback decoder.

### Actual copied-store qualification

Sourceff5 successfully decodes this target-prepared plan. Every other Goal fact is compared exactly; source-less Goals remain source-less. The authenticated old format had no commander; its ordinary case becomes UncommandedGoalAuthor, never a fabricated commander identity. Existing Todo stores still refuse implicit assignment/acceptance carry; this root has none.

All six originals rechecked unchanged after qualification at08:55:59Z. Evidence: `.artifacts/p107-operation6-qualified-plan.json`, `.artifacts/p107-operation6-owner-sites.txt`. Owned qualification candidate: `/home/ts/.cache/agent-scratch/gr107/operation6-qualification` (not installed).

Full parse:1336 modules, zero omissions; generic verbose traversal timed out. Focused before/after NRA declarations/writes/decisions/imports/consumers completed against immutable16a/current tools and actual target owner classes. Arbitrary dynamic getattr/callback/MRO resolution is not established by syntax evidence.

### Actual operation6: converted, stopped, publication failed
Codex ran e475 exactly once. All3 actual stored Goal holders equal the converted candidates (1045 authors), all3 preimages equal their originals, and the other5 protected originals remain equal. Typed actual-root inspection: registry37Goals=25ordinary+12source-less; releases22=21ordinary+1source-less; history999ordinary+59empty. Source-less authors refuse; no invented identity. The source worker exited and stayed stopped (owner13814/admission16259); private prefix remained T055936. Operation6's in-memory handoff ended with failure. No carry replay, rollback or old decoder launch.

### Publication owner correction and fresh target-only recovery
Current tool code41618135ba4164413b9d78e5cc9c834bff942f2e. `publish_runtime.py:63–70` calls the installed StatusCliCommand.run directly under the caller's held route instead of spawning another CLI that refuses its own EX lock. Original exceptions propagate; only a nonzero command result raises refusal with its actual JSON stdout. The redundant CoreError exception boundary was removed at review. Ordinary publication owns SH in main; stopped publication retains its existing EX. The original source-schema subprocess remains necessary and unchanged.

Actual converted-root status readback under EX passed, preserving protected store/guard hashes and old private pointer: `.artifacts/p107-owned-readback.json`. Before/after NRA tool+actual-target census380modules/zero omissions: `.artifacts/p107-route-readback-owner-sites.txt`; dynamic resolution remains explicitly unproven. Production src unchanged.

No main enqueue loop, carry repeat, operation6 replay or old decoder. The existing owner legitimately writes coordination startup data; compare pre-start hashes and actual post-start changes rather than assuming no startup effects. Actual fresh416 publication moved private current toT061350, then the operator mistakenly truth-tested InputDocument rather than rows. Read-only rows count was0; Claude separately authorized one start-only step. Actual worker3710799/start170479330, owner13815/admission16260 is running onT061350. All37 registry Goals equal candidate (25ordinary+12source-less), release21ordinary+1source-less/history999 exact candidate bytes; all five other original hashes remain unchanged after actual saved-fork UI load. Unresolved rows0. Source-less author access still refuses. Actual private history/editor Ready shown; no new input. No pointer/start operation was performed by this implementation owner.

Evidence `.artifacts/p107-{after-start,after-ui}-preservation.json`; physical screenshot `gr107/stopped-proof-1/ui-after-stopped-home/ready.png`. The old C8 private pair is qualification, not a replacement for newer public P130/P108. Current-main c02 is handed to Codex for a fresh paired PRIVATE target; no carry/operation5/6 replay.
